shots.title: Notice served
shots.description: A furious blond superhero squints at an eviction notice.

shots.title: The penthouse
shots.description: His luxury fortress is a pile of cardboard boxes beneath a bridge.

shots.title: Superpowered gust
shots.description: The whole hero launches through the air, sending a furious gust along the street.

shots.title: Deposit gone
shots.description: The blast destroys the cardboard fortress. Its panels tumble away independently.

shots.title: Victory inspection
shots.description: He returns for his triumphant victory pose as his address falls from the sky.

shots.title: No forwarding address
shots.description: The hero stares at his ruined box. The security deposit has blown away.

title: Master Cheese: Cheddar Command
tagline:
Finish the fight.
Refrigerate after opening.

shots.title: Combat ready
shots.description: A stern green visor peers out of scratched cheddar armor.

shots.title: Dairy division
shots.description: The cheese soldier shoulders an enormous box-grater rifle in a cold-storage loading bay.

shots.title: Cheddar rounds
shots.description: The grater recoils as a volley of cheddar shavings accelerates across the bay.

shots.title: Grated
shots.description: The shavings burst against a stack of supply tins, scattering it across the floor.

shots.title: Mission complete
shots.description: The soldier straightens for a proud military salute. His armor begins to sag.

shots.title: Shelf life expired
shots.description: He keeps saluting while his cheesy victory slowly melts. A refrigeration reminder lands beside him.

title: MrLeast: Microscopic Giveaway
tagline:
The biggest announcement.
The smallest prize.

shots.title: Huge announcement
shots.description: A manic giveaway host grins as a spotlight snaps on.

shots.title: Oversized generosity
shots.description: He unveils a presentation cheque almost larger than the stage.

shots.title: Promotional damage
shots.description: The host swings the enormous board through the giveaway set.

shots.title: Cheque delivered
shots.description: The giant cheque crashes down and sends the cheap stage props tumbling.

shots.title: Actual prize
shots.description: He proudly pinches the real prize between two fingers: one tiny dollar.

shots.title: Applause pending
shots.description: The host waits for a standing ovation. One piece of confetti drifts past the dollar.
The suited fighter looks at his watch through dark glasses.

shots.title: Contracted hours
shots.description: He loosens his spotted tie beside the office time clock.

shots.title: Overtime approved
shots.description: The clock hits eighteen hundred. He draws his wrapped blade and makes one clean rush.

shots.title: One paid strike
shots.description: A single bright strike scatters a stack of overdue paperwork.

shots.title: Clocking out
shots.description: He calmly presents his timecard and picks up his briefcase.

shots.title: Shift over
shots.description: The fighter walks away. The time clock is left to finish the battle.

shots.title: Behold
shots.description: A white and violet alien clerk gives a terrifyingly smug look.

shots.title: Final form
shots.description: He proudly presents a white chest freezer in the frozen-food aisle.

shots.title: Cold storage
shots.description: The alien awkwardly climbs into his own appliance.

shots.title: Minus eighteen
shots.description: Cold mist and ice shards burst around the freezer, forming a protective frost barrier.

shots.title: Maximum efficiency
shots.description: He shivers inside the chest freezer while trying to retain a commanding expression.

shots.title: Clocked out
shots.description: The lid closes. He peeks out once, then hides from the rest of the incident.

shots.title: Witness me
shots.description: A horned corporate presenter grins with far too much confidence.

shots.title: The blood deck
shots.description: She raises a red presentation remote in front of a mandatory training screen.

shots.title: Next slide
shots.description: Rapid clicks summon a storm of presentation pages.

shots.title: Paper shield
shots.description: The pages gather into an enormous protective paper shield for the squad.

shots.title: Slide ninety-seven
shots.description: The presenter proudly explains a completely useless pie chart.

shots.title: Questions mandatory
shots.description: She waits smugly for questions. The presentation keeps going.

title: Kobeni Minimum Wage: Minimum-Wage Miracle
tagline:
All plates saved.
No wages found.

shots.title: Lunch rush
shots.description: An anxious server clutches a tray with a sandwich and drink.

shots.title: No benefits
shots.description: The tray tilts while she tries to keep smiling for the customer.

shots.title: Minimum-wage miracle
shots.description: She slips, twists and catches the meal without dropping it.

shots.title: Lunch saved
shots.description: Plates arc safely into place, delivering lunch to the squad.

shots.title: The tip
shots.description: She presents the perfect tray and waits for a tip.

shots.title: Unpaid invoice
shots.description: The receipt says zero. The exhausted server gives one last forced smile.

title: Gordon Ramen: Instant Noodle Inspection
tagline:
A very serious tasting.
A very instant dinner.

shots.title: Taste test
shots.description: A furious blond chef holds a magenta instant-noodle cup and fork.

shots.title: Not acceptable
shots.description: He tastes one noodle and recoils in disgust.

shots.title: Noodle inspection
shots.description: His next fork gesture sends a long noodle whip across the kitchen.

shots.title: Knot accepted
shots.description: The noodles coil into an enormous tangled knot.

shots.title: The verdict
shots.description: The chef inspects the aftermath with complete disapproval.

shots.title: Sent back
shots.description: After all that destruction, he still refuses the dinner.

shots.title: One impossible story
shots.description: A long-nosed pirate proudly enters a prompt into his phone.

shots.title: Fact check offline
shots.description: He makes a completely impossible claim beside a suspicious printing machine.

shots.title: Generating canon
shots.description: The machine feeds a storm of pages into his arms.

shots.title: Plot armor delivered
shots.description: The pages become a cannon-sized book and crash across the print shop.

shots.title: Publication date
shots.description: He proudly presents the newly published story, struggling under its weight.

shots.title: The lie is canon
shots.description: The liar poses with his enormous book. The lie now has a publication date.

shots.title: The moderator
shots.description: A smug moderator opens a black notebook.

shots.title: The black notebook
shots.description: He raises his pen beside a wall of glowing moderation screens.

shots.title: Username entered
shots.description: One furious written username unleashes a wave of ban notices.

shots.title: Channel deleted
shots.description: An enormous ban stamp slams across the monitors.

shots.title: The perfect purge
shots.description: He admires the perfect purge, then notices a missing channel.

shots.title: Tech support banned
shots.description: The appeal channel and tech support are both gone. The moderator stares at his notebook in panic.

title: Copy-Paste Kakashi: Photocopy Jutsu
tagline:
A thousand techniques.
One office printer.

shots.title: Copy the stance
shots.description: A masked silver-haired ninja prepares a copied technique.

shots.title: Office ninja
shots.description: He leans over a photocopier in a very suspicious dojo.

shots.title: Photocopy jutsu
shots.description: The printer produces a paper clone of the entire ninja.

shots.title: Watermarked
shots.description: The clone charges in the wrong direction while watermarked paper flies across the room.

shots.title: Paper handling
shots.description: The original tries to make sense of the printed instructions.

shots.title: Wrong direction
shots.description: He holds the instructions upside down. The clone has no paper handling skills.

title: Sauron Surveillance: One Eye to Track Them All
tagline:
Search history acquired.
Cookies are mandatory.

shots.title: Always watching
shots.description: A flaming surveillance eye narrows inside a spiked black tower.

shots.title: Privacy tower
shots.description: The tower watches an empty corporate courtyard through its attached cameras.

shots.title: Profile acquired
shots.description: A scanning cone sweeps the street and creates a fictional profile.

shots.title: Mandatory policy
shots.description: An impossibly long privacy policy crashes through the courtyard.

shots.title: Consent required
shots.description: The eye tries to keep its terrifying stare as cookies gather below.

shots.title: Accept all
shots.description: The eye also accepts all cookies. The privacy policy remains enormous.

title: Infinite Rizz: Domain Expansion: Main Character

shots.title: No eye contact
shots.description: A white-haired show-off lifts the edge of his black blindfold.

shots.title: The main character
shots.description: He makes a finger seal above the neon city.

shots.title: Personal space
shots.description: A domain grows around his intact body while an incoming attack slows to a stop.

shots.title: Infinity
shots.description: Infinity holds the attack at a humiliating distance and returns the entire gesture.

shots.title: Rizz secured
shots.description: He relaxes into a smug victory pose.

shots.title: Blindfold malfunction
shots.description: His blindfold slips. He tries to rescue his dignity while the domain keeps working.

title: Big Bald Energy: One Punch, One Coupon
tagline:
A perfectly ordinary punch.
An extraordinary discount.

shots.title: Sale day
shots.description: A bored bald hero checks his grocery coupon.

shots.title: The coupon
shots.description: He waits outside a battered discount supermarket with his shopping bag.

shots.title: Almost some effort
shots.description: One restrained punch travels through eight whole-body drawings.

shots.title: One punch
shots.description: A giant shock front clears the forecourt while his groceries stay safe.

shots.title: The real priority
shots.description: He immediately checks the coupon again.

shots.title: Expired
shots.description: The coupon expired yesterday. The victory receives no further attention.

shots.title: This time
shots.description: A furious black-haired warrior expects to win this time.

shots.title: The charge
shots.description: He braces in an empty tournament arena.

shots.title: Final flash
shots.description: His hands come together and thrust forward as the enormous beam charges.

shots.title: Maximum effort
shots.description: A colossal golden beam tears across the arena.

shots.title: Awaiting results
shots.description: He waits for his award, already smiling.

shots.title: Runner-up
shots.description: A silver medal arrives. The podium still says second place. He has a very small tantrum.

title: Fraudo Baggins: One Ring to Refer Them All
tagline:
A once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
For every new referral.

shots.title: The pitch
shots.description: A smiling hobbit shows a tiny gold ring.

shots.title: The referral Shire
shots.description: He opens his investment pitch in a suspiciously welcoming Shire courtyard.

shots.title: One ring
shots.description: He throws the ring and it grows into a gigantic gold referral loop.

shots.title: Refer them all
shots.description: The loop sweeps a wall of guaranteed-return claims across the courtyard.

shots.title: Guaranteed returns
shots.description: The welcome carpet begins rolling out from under him.

shots.title: The rug pull
shots.description: The carpet unravels the entire pitch. The conman lands flat and tries to keep smiling.

title: Daenerys Airfryer: Dracarys, Preheat
tagline:
Mother of countertop appliances.
Breaker of cooking timers.

shots.title: The queen
shots.description: A platinum-haired queen commands the room.

shots.title: Three appliances
shots.description: Three black dragon-head air fryers wait in the throne-room kitchen.

shots.title: Dracarys
shots.description: Her grand command is answered by a preheating countdown.

shots.title: Preheat complete
shots.description: All three appliances launch a small scorched projectile after the ready chime.

shots.title: The royal result
shots.description: She waits for an appropriately royal result.

shots.title: One tiny morsel
shots.description: The queen inspects one tiny crisped morsel. The appliances are very pleased with themselves.

title: L Ratio: Case Closed, Ratio Open

shots.title: The detective
shots.description: An exhausted detective studies his black tablet.

shots.title: The reply scene
shots.description: He inspects an empty alley through an enormous magnifying glass.

shots.title: Evidence delivered
shots.description: A barrage of evidence cards travels toward the reply board.

shots.title: Case closed
shots.description: Every point receives a perfect verdict, then a huge letter L lands on the board.

shots.title: The public verdict
shots.description: He checks the public reply count and cannot believe it.

shots.title: Take the L
shots.description: The evidence is still correct. The detective has been comprehensively ratioed.

title: Yasuo 0/10: Windwall of Excuses
tagline:
One flawless sword technique.
Ten flawless excuses.

shots.title: The swordsman
shots.description: A disheveled swordsman prepares his weapon.

shots.title: Choose a lane
shots.description: The neon street splits into two very clear lanes.

shots.title: Perfect dash
shots.description: He dashes forward through an elaborate wind wall.

shots.title: Wrong exit
shots.description: The slash clears the wrong exit and the defeat counter reaches ten.

shots.title: The scoreboard
shots.description: He finally notices the scoreboard.

shots.title: Team difference
shots.description: The tenth defeat is definitely everyone else's fault.
